incident.summary: Declassified summary of an extraterrestrial assault on Manhattan and the joint response that contained it. A portal opened above the city, hostile infantry deployed into midtown, and civilian evacuation continued while the breach was closed.
observations: The portal stayed open long enough for a coordinated ground assault.
Damage was concentrated in midtown infrastructure and transit corridors.
Containment required combined air, ground, and emergency-service coordination.
incident.conclusion: The file is retained as a declassified reference for urban extraterrestrial response. No active operational restriction remains on this record.
